bio.title: My Story
bio.p1: My journey in technology began in technical support and hospital administration, which gave me a solid foundation in empathy, user service and problem-solving.
bio.p2: When I moved into software development, I found my true passion: transforming complex ideas into simple, memorable digital experiences. I started as an intern at Ericsson, where I worked with .NET and process automation. Shortly afterward, I founded Habaeb Creative Solutions, my freelance studio focused on landing pages, websites and custom systems.
bio.p3: In 2024, I took the lead of the development team at Deploy Experience, coordinating front-end and full-stack projects for diverse clients. Today, I work as a front-end developer at Quantflow (Heerbrugg, St Gallen), combining React, Next.js and TypeScript with robust Django back-ends, and integrating language models (LLMs) to add intelligence to applications.
bio.p4: What sets me apart is the ability to combine deep technical knowledge with a user‑oriented product vision. I believe technology should solve real business problems and deliver intuitive experiences. Outside of work, I love exploring design, studying new languages and collaborating with the community. I'm always open to conversations about projects, partnerships and ways to apply technology strategically.

faq.question: How much does a professional website cost?
faq.answer: Landing pages start at $990, business sites at $1,990, and enterprise projects are quoted after a free discovery call. Final price depends on pages, integrations and custom design.

faq.question: How long until it's ready?
faq.answer: Landing page: 1-2 weeks. Business site: 3-5 weeks. Portal with integrations: 6-10 weeks. Always delivered in weekly sprints with live demos.

faq.question: Do you work with international clients?
faq.answer: Yes. Headquartered in Brazil, we serve clients across the US, Canada, UK, and EU remotely. Meetings on Google Meet, delivery via Git.

faq.question: Will the site be responsive and fast?
faq.answer: Yes. Mobile-first, tested across devices, 90+ Google PageSpeed score. Next.js, global CDN, automatic image optimization.

faq.question: Can I update the site myself later?
faq.answer: Yes. Every project above Essential ships with an integrated CMS admin panel. You update text, images and posts without a developer.

faq.question: Do I own the code?
faq.answer: 100% yours from commit #1. You get the Git repo. We only charge hosting if you want us to manage it — otherwise, host wherever you prefer.

faq.question: Do you do SEO?
faq.answer: We handle technical SEO (sitemap, robots, schema, performance, hreflang, OG image). Content SEO and link building is a separate service we also offer.

faq.question: I already have a site — can you rebuild it?
faq.answer: Yes. We redesign with content migration, SEO preservation (301 redirects), and no ranking loss. Usually the ranking improves significantly.

faq.question: How much does it cost to build a SaaS?
faq.answer: MVP starts at $9,900 in 8 weeks. Full Product from $22,900 in 12-16 weeks. Enterprise is quoted after discovery. Final price depends on complexity, integrations and planned scale.

faq.question: How long until MVP is ready?
faq.answer: 8-12 weeks for a functional MVP. Already ready for first paying users, with auth, billing and core flow working end-to-end.

faq.question: Is the code mine or yours?
faq.answer: 100% yours from commit #1. You get the Git repo, Stripe, Vercel, Supabase access. Zero lock-in.

faq.question: Do you support after delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. 45 to 90 days included depending on package. After that, optional monthly retainer (4h, 8h or 16h/month) for maintenance, new features and evolution.

faq.question: What stack do you use?
faq.answer: Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind on frontend. Supabase or PostgreSQL + Node.js/Python on backend. Stripe for billing. Vercel for deploy. Adapted per case.

faq.question: Do you integrate AI into SaaS?
faq.answer: Yes, natively. OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models via Ollama. Chat, content generation, document analysis, RAG with your data, autonomous agents.

faq.question: What if I need to scale to 100k users?
faq.answer: Architecture is built ready: edge functions, global CDN, read-replica database, caching. At enterprise scale, we migrate to dedicated infra (AWS/GCP) without major refactoring.

faq.question: Do you do AI integration outside of SaaS too?
faq.answer: Yes — see our AI Automation page. We integrate ChatGPT, Claude and agents into existing systems as well.

faq.question: Does AI replace my team?
faq.answer: No — well-done AI augments the team. It takes away repetitive, boring tasks so people can focus on creativity, empathy and judgment. It's a tool, not a replacement.

faq.question: How much does AI cost to run monthly?
faq.answer: Depends on volume. A WhatsApp chatbot with 1,000 interactions/month costs ~$20-60 in OpenAI tokens. More sophisticated agents can go to $100-400/month. We always show cost projection upfront.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. We use APIs with no-training clauses (OpenAI Enterprise, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI). For ultra-sensitive data, we run open-source models (Llama, Mistral) on-premise — zero external leakage.

faq.question: Does AI answer incorrectly sometimes?
faq.answer: Any LLM can hallucinate. We implement guardrails: answers limited to your docs (RAG), output validation, human handoff when uncertain. Typical precision 92-97% in well-defined cases.

faq.question: ChatGPT or Claude — which to use?
faq.answer: Depends. Claude 3.5/4 is better at reasoning, long-form writing and code. GPT-4o/5 is faster and cheaper for simple tasks. We recommend after understanding the case. Also test open-source when it makes sense.

faq.question: Can you integrate with WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Yes. Via WhatsApp Business API (Twilio, Gupshup, Z-API) or Evolution API. CRM integration, auto-responses, interactive buttons, lists, media.

faq.question: What if I don't know where to start?
faq.answer: That's exactly why we do free Process Mapping in the initial meeting. In 45min we identify the 2-3 processes with highest automation ROI and show a viable path.

faq.question: Do you work with n8n or build custom code?
faq.answer: Both. n8n is great for quick prototypes and simple integrations. When performance, scale or complex logic is needed, we move to custom code (Node.js, Python). We pick the right tool for each problem.
